leakage_boundary.forbidden_use: A deposited ensemble that was generated or selected using an observable may not predict that observable as held-out evidence.
leakage_boundary.future_denominator_rule: Single-structure and short conventional-MD denominators must use the same public inputs, observable forward models, and sampling budget ledger.
leakage_boundary.future_protein_holdout: Leave-one-protein-out evaluation must fit all model choices without any observable from the held-out UniProt accession.
leakage_boundary.future_training_rule: Every candidate ensemble must be regenerated using training observables only; acceptance observables remain unopened until prediction files are frozen.
